name: kb-agent-aws
description: AWS-native Knowledge Base Agent (RAG): CDK infrastructure, authenticated API, local Streamlit client

scripts._comment: Entry points from the repository root. The CDK app lives in infra/, and running cdk from anywhere else fails with '--app is required' -- these wrappers remove that trap.
scripts.deploy: npm run build:lambda && npm --prefix infra run deploy -- --require-approval never
scripts.test: npm run test:python && npm run test:infra
